==> quadlet/mylab-immich-db-main.container
# Generated by MyLab. Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

[Unit]
Description=MyLab immich: database main (postgres)

[Container]
ContainerName=mylab-immich-db-main
Image=ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres:14-vectorchord0.4.3-pgvectors0.2.0@sha256:bcf63357191b76a916ae5eb93464d65c07511da41e3bf7a8416db519b40b1c23
Network=mylab-immich.network
Environment=POSTGRES_USER=immich
Environment=POSTGRES_DB=immich
Environment=POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE=/run/secrets/db-password
Secret=mylab-immich-db-main-password,type=mount,target=db-password
Volume=/srv/mylab/services/immich/db/main:/var/lib/postgresql/data
HealthCmd=pg_isready -U immich -d immich
HealthInterval=10s
HealthStartPeriod=30s
Notify=healthy
Label=io.mylab.service=immich
Label=io.mylab.component=db-main
ShmSize=128m

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

==> quadlet/mylab-immich-server.container
# Generated by MyLab. Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

[Unit]
Description=MyLab immich: server
Requires=mylab-immich-db-main.service
After=mylab-immich-db-main.service
Requires=mylab-immich-db-cache.service
After=mylab-immich-db-cache.service

[Container]
ContainerName=mylab-immich-server
Image=ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:v2.1.0@sha256:72a9b9de6c6abfa7a9c9cdc244ae4d2bd9fea2ae00997f194cbd10aca72ea210
Network=mylab-immich.network
Network=mylab-proxy.network
Environment=DB_DATABASE_NAME=immich
Environment=DB_HOSTNAME=mylab-immich-db-main
Environment=DB_USERNAME=immich
Environment=IMMICH_MACHINE_LEARNING_ENABLED=false
Environment=IMMICH_MACHINE_LEARNING_URL=http://mylab-immich-machine-learning:3003
Environment=REDIS_HOSTNAME=mylab-immich-db-cache
Secret=mylab-immich-db-main-password,type=env,target=DB_PASSWORD
Volume=/srv/mylab/media/immich/library:/data
Volume=/srv/mylab/media/immich/encoded:/data/encoded-video
Volume=/srv/mylab/media/immich/thumbs:/data/thumbs
Label=io.mylab.service=immich
Label=io.mylab.component=server

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
